Environmental Scope (OUTDOOR). scope_applicability_on: outdoor ash and Both fog appear; indoor blue motes stay off. East is Fog & Motes (INDOOR): the same definitions filter differently. Inspect one name test at a time: scope_country_on/off (Country fog replaces Global cloud); scope_area_on/off (Area motes replace Country fog); scope_room_on/off (this room replaces Area motes); scope_disabled_on/off (this room has an explicit disabled replacement). scope_all_off clears probes. Phase and weather remain unchanged during the comparison. See BATCH_C_OBSERVATIONS.md.

Tuning & Bindings: top row left-to-right Recipe Defaults, Literal Overrides (blue), Ordinary Binding, Shared Binding, Computed Binding. Bottom left Optional Phase Binding has sources only on Spring Day; bottom middle is its 0.75-size fallback reference. phase_spring_night removes those sources: size uses literal 0.75, lifetime returns to recipe, optional motes use Enabled=true fallback. Spring Day binds false and suppresses motes. tune_* changes only the ordinary lane; shared_* writes from both participants; computed_boost_on/off drives numeric and string outputs. tuning_rain_on/off enables a same-recipe rate/lifetime/size comparison. Commands and expected results: BATCH_B_OBSERVATIONS.md and ObjectsLightsTuning.txt.

Triggered Bursts (INDOOR): five crate markers; no continuous emission. burst_sparks_a / burst_sparks_b / burst_water / burst_debris / burst_dust use recipe baseline counts. Add _half / _normal / _double / _zero to sparks_a, water, debris or dust for literal comparisons. burst_quantity_half/normal/double/zero changes BurstQuantity; burst_sparks_a_bound and burst_water_bound sample it when invoked. burst_boost_off/on selects computed 0.5x/2x; use burst_sparks_a_computed. burst_snapshot_pair queues half then double in one action. burst_sparks_a_tiny is a positive event that rounds to zero particles. burst_pair/all compare multiple sources; burst_source_east/south/west/north moves only Sparks A. South then north checks leave/revisit without replay. See BURST_QUANTITY_COVERAGE.md and CommandSequence/BurstQuantities.txt.

Commands: nextphase / previousphase cycle season and time; weather_none / weather_rain / weather_snow / weather_hail set precipitation; intensity_light / intensity_moderate / intensity_heavy / intensity_catastrophic set intensity; wind_north, wind_northeast, wind_east, wind_southeast, wind_south, wind_southwest, wind_west, wind_northwest set direction; wind_speed_still / wind_speed_breeze / wind_speed_windy / wind_speed_gale set speed. These controls are independent.

Lifecycle & Restore (INDOOR): smoke comparison row at y=160: Natural Smoke x=160, Timed Fade Smoke x=400 (2000 ms), Immediate Removal Smoke x=640 (0 ms). removal_all_on/off/hide/show controls the row; removal_natural_*, removal_fade_* and removal_immediate_* accept on/off/hide/show. Turn fade off then on within one second to inspect smooth cancellation. Run RemovalPolicies.txt from a fresh Shelter game for an isolated comparison; it temporarily hides the nearby Restore Beacon light. Existing life_smoke_*, life_fog_* and restore_beacon_* commands and genuine save/restore checkpoint remain. See REMOVAL_POLICY_COVERAGE.md.

Cloud isolation: cloud_1_on/off through cloud_4_on/off; clouds_all_on/off combines/clears four ordinary instances. Wind multipliers: 0.5 / 0.85 / 1.3 / 2.0; direction offsets: -30 / -10 / +15 / +40 degrees. Inspect each layer before combining, then wind_speed_gale, wind_south, wind_calm and breeze. These are sample-authored instances, not a component layer limit.

Image station: image_leaves_on/off uses the oval-leaf recipe with project custom leaf art; image_candle_show/hide uses a candle whose flame-tip slot alone has custom marker art. Its candle-flame and spark-glow slots still use packaged defaults. The marker intentionally reuses leaf artwork so replacement is recognizable. Image choices are project-wide per recipe/slot. For an exact same-recipe packaged-art comparison, start a new game from Variants/PackagedDefaults/GameRuntimeJson and repeat this route. Leave west to shelter, then revisit east to check cache reuse. See BATCH_C_OBSERVATIONS.md.

Visual Pipeline: left smoke and room motes are pre-light; right torch is post-light; faint fog is post-light. Center light sways/flickers and blue marker casts a shadow. Compare phase_spring_night and phase_spring_day. Go east to Phase & Light, then west, watching the outgoing/incoming transition image for sprites, both effect stages, lighting and shadows together. No new recipe variants are authored here.

Stains (INDOOR): splatter / patch / streak / directional spray are active object-attached effects, not triggered bursts. stain_splatter_east/south/west/north moves the first marker in a closed two-cell route: inspect whether the stain follows its object. stain_<splatter|patch|streak|spray>_hide/show and _disable/enable exercise removal and recreation. Observe retained marks and unexpected duplicates explicitly; a persistent stain is not an emitted particle trail. See BATCH_D_OBSERVATIONS.md.

The restore-torch fixture is retained for a later batch. Use season_spring / season_summer / season_fall / season_winter for Day in each season. weather_status reports state; phase_start selects Spring Dawn. Weather controls remain independent.
